def sgd_RWR(X,Y,alpha=0.01,epochs=100,batch_size=240, bias=0):
    m, n = X.shape
    w = np.zeros(n)
    itt_per_epoch = int(np.ceil(m/batch_size))
    loss_plot = []
    for i in range(epochs):
        for j in range(itt_per_epoch):
            indexes = np.random.choice(m, size=batch_size, replace=True)
            w -= alpha * gradw(X[indexes], Y[indexes], w, bias)
            bias -= alpha * gradb(X[indexes], Y[indexes], w, bias)
        loss_plot.append(MSE(X, Y, w, bias))
    return w, bias, loss_plot

notebook_cells.intuition: Shuffles dataset indices each epoch and slices sequential batches.

notebook_cells.title: In [331]: sgd_RWOR
notebook_cells.source:
def sgd_RWOR(X,Y,alpha=0.01,epochs=100,batch_size=240,bias=0):
    m, n = X.shape
    w = np.zeros(n)
    loss_plot = []
    for i in range(epochs):
        indexes = np.random.permutation(m)
        X_p, Y_p = X[indexes], Y[indexes]
        for j in range(0, m, batch_size):
            w -= alpha * gradw(X_p[j:j+batch_size], Y_p[j:j+batch_size], w, bias)
            bias -= alpha * gradb(X_p[j:j+batch_size], Y_p[j:j+batch_size], w, bias)
        loss_plot.append(MSE(X, Y, w, bias))
    return w, bias, loss_plot
